topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Well, well, looks like the streets are slick with more than just rain this time. Walked into the office, the usual trail of smoke and stale coffee, and there’s this guy, fidgeting more than a nagging wife on payday. Turns out, he’s got this thing, a gadget, you’d think it was the second coming of the wheel from how excited he was. Flashing me blueprints and schematics like it was the Holy Grail. But here’s the kicker—the patent office didn’t take too kindly to it. Seems another fella had the same bright idea and beat him to the punch. Now, he’s looking at me like I’m supposed to fix this. Like finding a straight man in this city. I lean back, take another drag, and let him know, this one’s got layers. We both know the stakes, and the shadows run long in this town.
